latest_release.name: v0.5.5
latest_release.body:
[中文](#cn-v0.5.5) | [English](#en-v0.5.5) `0.5.5` 补丁版本，汇总了自 `v0.5.4` 以来的主要变更。

问题修复

- 修复 PTC 在关闭常驻工具与动态加载时仍注册 `allowedTools` 候选池的问题：没有 loader 的作用域不再声明这些 API，首轮提示词不再多出约 22.5k tokens，常驻与默认加载行为不变。 @T-Auto - 修复 Native 搜索诊断丢失并统一模式契约（#867）。 @Haoming9527 The `0.5.5` patch release summarizes the main changes since `v0.5.4`.

Bug Fixes

- Fix a PTC scope with resident tools and dynamic loading off still registering the `allowedTools` pool; a loader-less scope now declares none of those APIs, removing roughly 22.5k tokens from the first prompt while resident and default behavior stay unchanged. by @T-Auto - Preserve Native search diagnostics and align mode contracts (#867). by @Haoming9527 **Full Changelog**: https://github.com/T-Auto/dsh-ops/compare/v0.5.4...v0.5.5
